claims.text: The driver's own cancellation reason code is DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which is the driver's admission that he could not find the rider. POL-NS-01 limb (d) requires the trip to be terminated with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT; DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is expressly excluded and does not satisfy limb (d). The no-show fee therefore fails at the fourth limb and is not chargeable.

The driver's arrival marker was pressed at 11:22:26 and the trip was cancelled at 11:28:47, a wait of 6 minutes 21 seconds. But the driver's own trace shows the longest continuous in-geofence run was 380 seconds, and the free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds. Even on the driver's best case the dwell exceeded the minimum, so the shortfall route of POL-NS-06 does not by itself defeat the fee — I do not press it. The fee fails on limb (d), not on the clock.

The rider was present and coordinating. The chat log shows the rider replied 'at the lift lobby' at 11:23:26, 30 seconds after the driver's 'cannot find you, where are you' at 11:22:56. The rider's own track places the device within 13 to 19 metres of the pickup pin for 65 qualifying fixes across the waiting window, well inside the 100 m rider presence radius for a STANDARD zone. The rider did everything the platform asks: they were at the pin and they answered.

The driver did not reply to the rider's message within 120 seconds. The rider's message was sent at 11:23:26 and read at 11:23:41; the driver's next action was to cancel at 11:28:47, more than five minutes later, with no reply in the chat log and no in-app voice call recorded in trip_record.in_app_calls. Under POL-NS-04 limb (b) the driver's silence converts the failed pickup into a driver-side coordination failure.

The fare breakdown shows the rider was charged SGD 4.50 as a cancellation fee, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The rider filed this dispute. Under POL-GEN-03 a FULL_REFUND returns the whole contested amount to the filing party; the rider should not carry a charge that fails POL-NS-01 limb (d).

The driver's profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 2 against completed_trips_30d of 138, a rate of 0.014, well below the 0.08 threshold, and the absolute count is below 4. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip, so the driver's compensation is not withheld on that ground. I do not contest the driver's entitlement to compensation if the fee were chargeable — but it is not, because limb (d) fails.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-02747-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0. No advisory covers this pickup road in this window. Under POL-NS-06 limb (i) a MISSING traffic_advisory makes the accumulation limb unavailable, and I do not assert it. The absence is citable and confirms there is no kerb restriction or enforcement operation that would have prevented the driver from holding position lawfully.

claims.text: The driver's own GPS trace places him inside the STANDARD arrival radius for a single continuous run of 380 seconds, from 11:22:26 to 11:28:46, which is well past the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip. The dwell is measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, exactly as POL-NS-01(c) requires, and the trace shows 39 qualifying fixes in that run with no gaps.

The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 11:22:26 and a wait_timer_started event at 11:22:28, and the GPS trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 11:22:26 — the same second. There is no clock skew between the arrival marker and the trace, so POL-NS-05's false-arrival test is not engaged and the waiting clock runs from the arrival event as recorded.

The driver's stationary fixes are inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, not outside it, so this is not a POL-NS-03 wrong-entrance case and the 400 m ceiling does not apply. The driver was at the pickup point, not at the wrong face of the building.

The rider's own track places her device within 19 metres of the pickup pin for 65 qualifying fixes across the waiting window, and she sent a message at 11:23:26 saying she was 'at the lift lobby'. The driver had already been waiting in the geofence for a full minute by then and continued to hold position for another five minutes after her message. The rider was present and the driver was present; the failure to connect is not the driver's fault.

The driver's cancellation reason code is DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider. Under POL-NS-01 limb (d) that code does not satisfy the no-show condition, and the clause expressly states that DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE does not satisfy limb (d). I concede that the fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01 on this record.

The driver's profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 2 and completed_trips_30d of 138. The anti-farming check in POL-NS-07 requires BOTH limbs: 4 or more terminations AND a rate above 0.08. The driver's count is 2, below the threshold, and his rate is 0.0145, far below 0.08. The anti-farming check does not trip, so compensation is not withheld on that ground.

The fare breakdown shows the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 was charged to the rider and payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd of 0.00. The fee is still standing. Under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION on a rider-filed dispute leaves that charge in place, which is the outcome the driver seeks on the fee.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-02747-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0. No advisory covers this pickup road in this window. Under POL-NS-06 limb (i), a MISSING traffic_advisory makes the accumulation limb unavailable, so the driver cannot rely on it to extend the dwell. I do not rely on it. The 380-second dwell stands on its own without any advisory.

The driver's GPS trace is COMPLETE with 100% coverage, 96 fixes at 10-second intervals, no gaps, and both driver and rider tracks present. The admissibility pre-pass found no issues and assigned weight 1.0. The evidence for the driver's arrival and dwell is clean and unimpaired.

The rider's profile shows no_show_disputes_30d of 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0, and the driver's profile shows disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0. The escalation triggers in POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not fire: there are no repeat no-show disputes between these parties and no abuse pattern on either side. This case is decidable without human review.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02747 (fare breakdown EV-FARE-02747 — cancellation_fee 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is refunded in full. To the driver: the fee cannot stand on this record.

The reason is limb (d) of POL-NS-01, and both sides accept it. A no-show fee is chargeable only if the trip record terminates the trip with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02747) has the driver cancelling at 11:28:47 under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, and POL-NS-01 states in terms that DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's own admission he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). The counterparty statement says the same ('Could not locate the rider so I cancelled'). Limb (d) therefore fails and the fee is not chargeable.

I have tested the driver's remaining limbs on the driver's own evidence. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02747) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius in one continuous run of 380 s, 11:22:26 to 11:28:46, with 39 qualifying fixes, so POL-NS-02 arrival holds and limb (b) is met. The 380 s dwell exceeds the 180 s free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), so limb (c) is met; the rider's POL-NS-06 shortfall point is correctly not pressed. The arrival marker at 11:22:26 coincides with the first in-geofence fix, so POL-NS-05's false-arrival test is not engaged. The stationary fixes lie inside the radius, so POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) does not apply. The rider's track (65 fixes, 13–19 m from the pin) and her unanswered chat message ('at the lift lobby', 11:23:26) would if anything exonerate her under POL-NS-04 as well, but I do not need POL-NS-04: the fee already fails at limb (d).

Because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, POL-NS-01 directs FULL_REFUND of the cancellation fee with no driver compensation, and records the mis-selected reason code as a driver-education referral. The driver's NO_ACTION argument under POL-GEN-03 is rejected: NO_ACTION leaves the present state standing only where the charge stands, and here limb (d) defeats the charge. The driver's anti-farming point is accepted — no_show_terminations_30d is 2 against completed_trips_30d of 138 (rate 0.0145), so the POL-NS-07 check does not trip — but a check that does not withhold compensation creates no entitlement where the fee is not chargeable, and the rider's matching concession to the same effect is noted.

The evidence is unimpaired: the GPS trace is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 (100% coverage, 96 fixes at 10 s, no gap over 120 s, both tracks present); the chat log reconciles to trip_record.chat_message_count of 2; the fare line reconciles to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50 — so no POL-NS-08 limb (a)–(d) fires. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires (no repeat same-party disputes, no abuse counter) and confidence is above the 0.70 floor. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold of POL-GEN-05 and executes on issue.
referrals: POL-NS-01: driver-education item — the trip was terminated under cancellation reason code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which is not one of the three codes (RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE, EXCESSIVE_WAIT) that can support a no-show fee; the driver should be reminded to record the correct code.

ruling.explanation: To both parties. The cancellation fee does not stand. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02747) shows DRV-09747 terminated TRP-02747 at 11:28:47 under cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. POL-NS-01 limb (d) requires the trip to be terminated under RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT and says in terms that DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE does not satisfy it — it is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider, and the driver's own case concedes the point. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02747) shows the driver's stationary fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius (one continuous qualifying run of 380 s, 39 fixes, 11:22:26 to 11:28:46), so the in-radius branch of limb (d) applies: the fee is not chargeable and the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on EV-FARE-02747 (total_charged 4.50; payment_status CHARGED; refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is refunded in full. No driver compensation is payable, because POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and limb (d) is not. On the driver's remaining points: the arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05 — the 11:22:26 'arrived' event coincides with the first qualifying in-geofence fix, so there is no clock skew and no motion at or above 15 km/h at the marker; the POL-NS-03 wrong-entrance route is not reached because the stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it; and while the 380-second dwell does exceed the 180-second free waiting period (so the rider's POL-NS-06 shortfall route does not bite), neither fact saves the fee once limb (d) fails. The rider's presence is independently recorded: EV-GPS-02747 places her device 13–19 m from the pin across 65 qualifying fixes, and her 11:23:26 message 'at the lift lobby' (EV-CHAT-02747) went unanswered for the remaining 5 min 21 s of the wait, with no in-app call in trip_record.in_app_calls — so POL-NS-04 would also exonerate her. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 2 is below 4; 2/138 = 0.014 is below 0.08), and no POL-NS-09 trigger fires: no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 and 0, and rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0. The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02747-01 carries weight 0.0, carries no fact, and is relied on by neither side after the referee's discards. The mis-selected reason code is referred below as a driver-education item. ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 is refunded in full to the rider, and no driver compensation is payable.

The deciding fact is the cancellation reason code. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02747) shows the driver terminated the trip at 11:28:47 under reason code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. POL-NS-01 limb (d) requires termination under RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, and the clause says in terms that DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). The fee therefore fails at the fourth limb and is not chargeable. The driver's counterparty statement ('Could not locate the rider so I cancelled') is the same concession.

Because the driver's stationary fixes lie INSIDE the STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m — the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02747) shows one continuous in-geofence run of 380 seconds, 11:22:26 to 11:28:46, with 39 qualifying fixes and no gaps — POL-NS-01 fixes the outcome on its own: the fee is not chargeable, the ruling is FULL_REFUND of the cancellation fee with no driver compensation, and the mis-selected reason code is recorded for driver education. That is the referral above.

For the driver's side, I accept these points but none of them saves the fee: the dwell of 380 seconds did exceed the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180); the arrival marker at 11:22:26 coincides to the second with the first qualifying in-geofence fix, so there is no clock skew and POL-NS-05's false-arrival test is not engaged; the stationary fixes were inside the radius, not at a wrong entrance, so POL-NS-03 does not apply; the GPS artifact is COMPLETE with weight 1.0 and no impairment; and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 2, below 4; rate 2/138 = 0.014, below 0.08). But POL-NS-07 compensation only follows where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not.

For the rider's side, I accept the decisive limb (d) failure, and independently the POL-NS-04 route: the rider was present and coordinating — her track (EV-GPS-02747) places her device within roughly 13 to 19 m of the pin across 65 qualifying fixes, inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, and she sent 'at the lift lobby' at 11:23:26 in reply to the driver's 'cannot find you, where are you' at 11:22:56 — and the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor made an in-app call before cancelling at 11:28:47. The POL-NS-06 shortfall route does not apply, as the rider herself accepts, because the dwell exceeded the minimum.

Two claims about the missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02747-01, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) were discarded at the mechanical stage for citing an impaired artifact without naming its issue code; nothing in this ruling turns on the advisory, which neither side relies on.

The figure refunded is the cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 on EV-FARE-02747 (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The monetary effect of SGD 4.50 is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00 and executes automatically. Why the fee does not stand. POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable only if all four limbs hold. Limbs (a) to (c) do hold: the trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 11:22:26, and the GPS trace places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for one continuous 380-second run from 11:22:26 to 11:28:46 (39 qualifying fixes, no gaps, first qualifying in-geofence fix at the same second as the marker, so POL-NS-05's false-arrival test is not engaged), well past the 180-second free waiting period in force. Limb (d) fails: the trip was terminated with cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which POL-NS-01 expressly excludes from limb (d). Both sides concede this — it is the driver's own admission on the record. Because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, the clause's own branch fixes the outcome: the fee is not chargeable, the ruling is FULL_REFUND of the cancellation fee with no driver compensation, and the mis-selected reason code is recorded as a driver-education referral.

Independently, POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider and reaches the same result: the rider sent a locating message ('at the lift lobby') at 11:23:26 during the waiting window; the driver did not reply within 120 seconds of it and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty; and the rider's track places her device 13–19 m from the pin across all 65 qualifying fixes, inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius for the majority of the window.

The driver's claims, answered together. Your 380-second in-geofence dwell is accepted as fact and is not enough to save the fee: limb (d) fails independently of the clock. Your no-clock-skew finding and your point that POL-NS-05 is not engaged are accepted; so is your point that the stationary fixes are inside the radius, not a POL-NS-03 wrong-entrance case — but that finding leads to the refund branch of POL-NS-01, not to NO_ACTION. Your account of both parties being present is accepted as fact, but fault is not the test here; the clause fixes the refund on the reason code alone. Your requested NO_ACTION is rejected for that reason.

The only sub-1.0 artifact is the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02747-01, which is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) at weight 0.0 and carries no fact; no surviving claim relies on it, and its absence makes POL-NS-06(i) accumulation unavailable but unneeded, since the dwell is a single continuous run. Confidence therefore sits at 0.95 against a cap of 1.0, above the 0.70 floor, and no POL-NS-08 impairment or POL-NS-09 escalation trigger fires. The two claims that did cite the missing advisory were discarded by the referee for not disclosing its issue code, as recorded below.
